slides.title: Collections Module
slides.content:
# `collections` 🧰

## `deque`
Double-ended queue. O(1) appends/pops from both ends.

## `Counter`
Counts hashable objects.
```python
Counter('aabbbc') # {'b':3, 'a':2, 'c':1}
```

## `defaultdict`
Dict that never raises KeyError.
```python
d = defaultdict(int)
d['a'] += 1 # Works! Starts at 0
```

## `namedtuple`
Lightweight object class.
```python
Point = namedtuple('Point', ['x', 'y'])
p = Point(10, 20)
print(p.x)
```

slides.title: Itertools
slides.content:
# `itertools` ♾️

## Combinatorics
- `permutations(p, r)`: Order matters (ABC != CBA).
- `combinations(p, r)`: Order doesn't matter (ABC == CBA).

## Iterators
- `chain(a, b)`: Iterate a then b.
- `cycle(a)`: Loop infinitely.
- `islice(a, start, end)`: Slice an iterator.

```python
list(combinations([1,2,3], 2))
# [(1,2), (1,3), (2,3)]
```

slides.title: Built-in Functions
slides.content:
# Functional Tools 🔧

## `map(func, iter)`
Apply function to every item.
```python
nums = [1, 2, 3]
squares = map(lambda x: x**2, nums)
```

## `filter(func, iter)`
Keep items where func returns True.
```python
evens = filter(lambda x: x%2==0, nums)
```

## `zip(iter1, iter2)`
Combine lists in parallel.
```python
names = ['a', 'b']
ages = [20, 30]
pairs = list(zip(names, ages)) # [('a', 20), ('b', 30)]
```
